### Centific Announces Leadership Transition: Chuen Hong Lew to Succeed Venkat Rangapuram as Chief Executive Officer

Centific appoints Chuen Hong Lew, former Singapore IMDA CEO, as its new Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram effective Aug 3, 2026.

Published on Aug 3, 2026, 3 min read time, Table of contents, Topics, Leadership Transition, AI Industry, Executive Appointment, Corporate News, Author(s), Centific
#### Former Granite Asia Partner to Lead Centific's Next Phase of Growth as a Global Data and AI Solutions Provider.

Centific, a leading global data and AI solutions company, today announced that Chuen Hong Lew will become Chief Executive Officer, effective August 3, 2026, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram, who has led the company through a period of significant growth and global expansion.

Chuen Hong joins Centific from Granite Asia, where he served as a Partner, leading the firm's partnerships ecosystem and special strategic projects. This gave him broad visibility into the AI ecosystem and the dynamics shaping the sector.

“Chuen Hong is well positioned to lead Centific as we accelerate our ambition to become a leading global data and AI solutions company,” said Tiak Koon Loh, Chairman of the Board of Centific.

# Centific Board Appoints Venkat Rangapuram as Chief Executive Officer

Rangapuram to Continue the Tech Company’s Growth and Industry Influence as it Continues Commitment to Data-Driven, Intelligent Experiences for Enterprise Clients

**Redmond, WA (PRUnderground) March 11th, 2020**

Centific, a world-class digital solution provider for the data-driven, intelligent enterprise, announced today its Board of Directors has unanimously appointed Venkat Rangapuram as the company’s Chief Executive Officer.

Rangapuram has held multiple senior positions at both Pactera and Pactera EDGE – most recently as the company’s Senior Vice President and General Manager.
He brings a wealth of knowledge and experience to his new role and has had a successful track record in transforming the company’s various business units into the digital paradigm over the last few years. Most significantly, Rangapuram has demonstrated the unique capability to effectively translate complex business and technology challenges to strategic business solutions, and then communicate these solutions to Pactera EDGE’s enterprise clients.

“In my new role, we’re going to maintain the company’s successful strategy of focusing on Data, Intelligence and Experiences that’ve helped our clients achieve new levels of performance,” said Venkat Rangapuram, Centific’s new CEO. “But, at the same time, we’re looking forward to launching brand new digital business capabilities and initiatives designed to drive our own relevance, revenue, and growth in the industry.”
Centific, the Redmond, Washington-based business unit recently spun off from Centific Technologies, serves top Fortune 500 clients with an array of IT services, delivering top-tier engineering and globalization services on an enterprise scale. Under Rangapuram, the company will continue its global presence in strategic delivery centers across the U.S., India, China, APAC, and EU.

“We’ve got a lot of exciting new products in the pipeline, specifically developed to leverage the emerging power of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning,” reports Rangapuram. “Each of these solutions will address the primary needs of our modern enterprise clients such as data infrastructure and monetization, intelligence across the organization, and transformational B2B and B2C experiences.”

Rangapuram assumes the CEO position at Centific immediately.

To learn more about Centific and its services visit: **[https://www.centific.com](http://www.centific.com/)**

For media inquiries contact: **[lynn@maracaibomedia.com](mailto:lynn@maracaibomedia.com)**

**About Centific**
Centific is a global organization with offices in the US, Europe, India and Asia-Pacific. Clients include 100+ of the Global 500 companies, with industry concentration in Software and Technology, CPG, Retail, Logistics, Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, Food & Beverage, and Travel & Hospitality.

With a core focus on Data, Intelligence and Experience, Centific helps clients achieve new levels of performance, while adding brand new digital business capabilities to drive relevance, revenue, and growth. With clarity of vision, technological expertise, operational excellence, and a global footprint, Centific is the partner of choice for enterprises that want to run smarter – and for those that want to change the race.

Vasu joined Centific in late 2021 as the Senior Vice President and head of Digital Engineering, bringing with him over 25 years of experience building AI and Data platforms. His rich industry experience is bolstered by his time spent at the Indian School of Business Hyderabad, of which Vasu is a distinguished graduate. His significant contributions to Centific's innovative platforms and AI data solutions have been pivotal to the company's success, driving substantial advancements and market differentiation.

Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific, commented, "Vasu's visionary leadership has been a game-changer for us. His promotion to Chief Data and AI Officer is strategic for the entire trajectory of our company. Under his guidance, I'm confident that Centific will not only continue to lead the market but also accelerate our growth and scale new innovations that will set industry benchmarks."
In his enhanced role, Vasu will spearhead the strategic direction of Centific's data and AI operations, focusing on refining its flagship platforms—Centific Loop, Pitaya, and OneForma—and expanding its influence across global markets.

Reflecting on his new role, Vasu stated, "I am deeply honored by this opportunity to further influence the future of AI and data science at Centific. The landscape is ripe with potential, and I am eager to lead our talented teams to explore new horizons. Our commitment is to keep pushing the boundaries of what's possible, ensuring that our innovations not only meet but exceed the expectations of our clients."

This critical appointment comes at a time when Centific continues to stand at the vanguard of AI and data processing innovations. The tech industry is witnessing an unprecedented wave of opportunities for groundbreaking advancements.

results.title: Centific Appoints Vasudevan Sundarababu as Chief Data and AI Officer
results.snippet: Vasu joined Centific in late 2021 as the Senior Vice President and head of Digital Engineering, bringing with him over 25 years of experience building AI and Data platforms. His rich industry experience is bolstered by his time spent at the Indian School of Business Hyderabad, of which Vasu is a distinguished graduate. His significant contributions to Centific's innovative platforms and AI data solutions have been pivotal to the company's success, driving substantial advancements and market differentiation. Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific, commented, "Vasu's visionary leadership has been a game-changer for us. His promotion to Chief Data and AI Officer is strategic for the entire trajectory of our company. Under his guidance, I'm confident that Centific will not only continue to lead the market but also accelerate our growth and scale new innovations that will set industry benchmarks." In his enhanced role, Vasu will spearhead the strategic direction of Centific's data and AI operations, focusing on refining its flagship platforms—Centific Loop, Pitaya, and OneForma—and expanding its influence across global markets.
